depends_on.name: input_id
depends_on.documentation: The statement leaf(s) this value was COMPUTED from (its inputs). A statement with inputs in the dataset is a calculation; this edge is what makes it one. Typed to a statement leaf -- never an entity.

depends_on.name: interpreter_id
depends_on.documentation: Optional: the interpreter the producing run executed on (e.g. MATLAB R2023b, Python 3.11), as a `software` entity (name + version). Present whenever the calculator runs in one; absent for a compiled program, which has none (#73 item 53, made optional 2026-10-04; replaces the environment entity's interpreter / interpreter_version). The run's, not the calculator's supported interpreters.

depends_on.name: operating_system_id
depends_on.documentation: The operating system the producing run executed on (e.g. macOS 14.5), as a `software` entity (name + version). REQUIRED on every calculation (#73 item 53; replaces the environment entity's os / os_version). The run's OS, not the OS the software supports (openMINDS SoftwareVersion.operatingSystem).

fields.name: redundant
fields.documentation: True = this calculation adds NO information beyond its inputs: an exact, deterministic, choice-free rebuild exists (per-gene totals summed from the counts), so it is safe to delete. Most calculations are NOT redundant -- a clustering, a label transfer or a fit depends on method, version and randomness. Nothing may cite a redundant document as a provenance input (item 31; T6).
